title: 430 people cut off, one road gone: Zion, April 1995 #Shorts
description:
About four hundred and thirty people cut off, and one road gone. On the night of April twelfth, nineteen ninety-five, part of an ancient landslide in Zion moved again. It blocked the Virgin River, and the river cut a new path straight through the road. About six hundred feet of it was destroyed. Guests and employees at Zion Lodge were stuck. Crews carved an emergency detour out of the canyon wall in about twenty-two hours.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 2: The Day the Mountain Fell: Zion's Lost Lake): https://youtu.be/1KUANk1uGtU
